messages.author: 05308ae6dc513026
messages.subject: plotting mapmaker data
parts:
hello all,

I was hoping someone might be able to tell me how to access data.

For example, if i have a mapmaker data file
-----------------------
data type f2 intercross
x y z

*d1
*d2
*d3
...
*r1
*r2

-----------------------

The following code will plot the LOD scores of *r1, how do I plot the
LOD scores of *r2? I've tried out.em$lod[2,] and other possibilities,
but haven't hit it yet. Any help would be appreciated. thanks, david

library(qtl)
data <- read.cross("mm", dir="test", file="lod0.txt",
mapfile="mapfile.txt")
data <- calc.genoprob(data, step=2, err=0.01)
out.em <- scanone(data)
sig <- out.em$lod[out.em$lod > 4.3]
plot(out.em$lod, main="LOD scores for expr 1")

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: plotting mapmaker data
parts:
The function scanone() includes an argument "pheno.col" that indicates
which phenotype to use. By default it's the first column, and so the
code you provided did that. If you type:

out2.em <- scanone(data, pheno.col=2)

then "out2.em" will contain the results from doing the scan with the
second phenotype.

Note that it'd be better not to use "data" as the name of your data,
as that is a function sometimes needed in R/qtl, which would no longer
be available to you.

regards,
karl
